form: Proofreading is like washing dishes in more than one respect. Not on- ly is it an unexciting activity, especially in contrast with the preceding feast, but also, when you think you're all through, there are invariably some unnoticed items left -- in the case of dishwashing, coffee cups or glasses left on windowsills or mantlepiece, or, worse, one or more scorched pans right on the stove. Most of the following items fall in the coffee cup category. I hope the toughest pans were done before the MS was sent off.
